This lot includes 12 antique glass telegraph and telephone line insulators, primarily Hemingray brand, featuring Hemingray-42 and Hemingray-17 markings. One insulator is marked H.G. CO. The colors include aqua/teal green and clear glass. Each insulator has a classic beehive or dome ribbed top and a threaded skirt base with embossed manufacturer names. shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description:
Product Overview:
This framed oil painting features an elderly man with a long white beard, wearing a woven straw hat and holding a smoking pipe. The artwork is rendered in a realistic style with visible brush strokes and a soft, muted color palette.

Specifications:
- Medium: Oil on canvas
- Subject: Elderly man with straw hat and smoking pipe
- Style: Realistic with visible brush strokes
- Color Palette: Soft, muted tones
- Frame: Bamboo-style wooden frame with textured brown mat
- Backing: Black paper with hanging wire
- Dimensions: 23.5 x 19.5 inches including frame

Additional Details:
The frame exhibits a rustic, vintage appearance. There are no visible artist signatures or identifying marks on the front.

description:
Brazilian Agate Geode Bookend
Polished Natural Agate with Blue Enhancement
Mid-to-Late 20th Century Lapidary Decor
This natural Brazilian agate geode section has been cut and polished to highlight intricate concentric banding and a crystalline quartz core, enhanced with a vibrant blue dye treatment. Popularized during the mid-to-late 20th century as functional desk accessories and display specimens, cut geode bookends highlight organic geological formations alongside geometric lapidary craftsmanship.
Natural agate geode featuring fine banding surrounding a crystalline quartz center
Polished front face and upright surface with preserved natural rough rind on the exterior
Equipped with three protective green felt pads on the base to prevent surface scratching
Measures approximately 5 inches tall, 3.5 inches long, and 2.5 inches wide, weighing 2.1 lbs
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The polished faces display a smooth, lustrous finish with clearly defined banding. The rough exterior shows typical geological texture and variations inherent to natural stone formation. Base felt pads are intact. Free of chips, cracks, or damage beyond natural mineral characteristics.

shipping.policy:
Shipping:
Shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). Orders will be shipped within
5 business days
(Monday-Friday) of payment. However, we make every effort to ship sooner. Shipping may be delayed in the event of unforeseen business closure for holidays, disasters, etc.
Our shipping software shops for the best shipping option for your order. The carrier that the item is listed with may not be the carrier with which the item(s) ship.
Combined Shipping:
Items may be combined to save on shipping charges if the auctions close within 7 days of each other, are safe to ship in one box, and we are contacted prior to payment. Once paid for, items are no longer eligible to be combined. Once a combined shipping charge has been calculated for an order, no additional items may be added to an order.
Because of how our carriers charge for shipping, item weight is calculated based on the dimensional weight and not the actual weight of the item. This can potentially add to the shipping charge of combined orders if larger shipping materials are required.
Most of our Jewelry items are listed with a flat rate shipping fee. If you purchase more than one item, please send a Customer Service ticket through your Shopgoodwill.com account before paying so that we can remove the flat rate fee. After the flat rate fees are removed shipping cost will be calculated directly from the courier's site. Art, glass, musical instruments, prepackaged lots, heavy items, and other fragile items may not be eligible for combined shipping.
We do not ship orders to PO Boxes.
You will need a physical street address to receive your packages.
Signature Verification
: For all orders $1000 or more, packages must be signed for by an adult in the household.
Attention:
Goodwill Middle TN is not responsible for lost or stolen packages after delivery to the customer has been confirmed with tracking information. Contact FedEx or USPS for further information.

description:
CONDITION: Some broken or missing items. Surface scratches and wear. Pre-Owned; Recommend Cleaning Before Use
May have surface scratches, patina, natural imperfections, scuffs and/or chips that may not be easily detected.
Item(s) are intended to be wearable, however some pieces may show signs of heavy use or damage. Photos shown on this listing are of the actual items being sold and should be viewed carefully. Condition and value of individual pieces will vary.
Metals and stones are not tested for material makeup unless otherwise noted.
Watches have not been professionally tested or serviced and we do not offer any guarantee on functionality or life of watches.
Unless otherwise stated in the listing, items do not come with official certificates and will not include documentation.
PRECIOUS METALS and GEMSTONE TESTING:
Where testing is indicated in the listing, gems are tested with a Presidium gem tester and confirmed by our
Certified Gemologist
; white stones such as diamonds are also tested with a GemOro Ultra 3+ tester. Please note this tester cannot differentiate between manufactured and natural stones. All precious metals including gold, silver, platinum and palladium are tested with acid testing.
NO RETURNS or REFUNDS:
Pieces are sold AS-IS and are NOT eligible for return or refund for any reason.
You are bidding with this in mind.
NON-PAYMENT:
Items not paid for by the deadline date will be relisted the next business day.
PICKUP ITEMS:
Local shoppers can avoid shipping costs by picking up in person at our warehouse within 2 weeks of purchase. Please submit a ticket promptly after payment with your preferred pickup day/time. We will respond with confirmation within 24-48 hours.
NOTE:
Items purchased for pickup MUST be picked up in our facility within 2 weeks of purchase date. Items not picked up by the deadline will be considered abandoned and will be re-donated back to Goodwill without refund.
COMBINING ORDERS:
If you wish to combine items, please do so before processing your items for payment. Please note, there are limits to the size and weight of items we can safely combine for shipping purposes and therefor we cannot always accommodate those requests.
DISCLAIMER:
All auctions are previously owned items in used condition that have been donated to Goodwill and sold to support our outreach services in the community. Items are sold as they are received. Items are not cleaned or repaired prior to being sold. Our staff are not experts in any field and cannot identify every detail or verify functionality of items. Details are provided to the best of our ability and any measurements are approximate. Please read and understand the description, as well as reviewing photos carefully, before placing your bid.

description: Large mixed lot containing rocks, minerals, crystals, and gemstones. Includes IMI Educational Outreach Rock Kit and Grandpa Shorter's rock identification kit with compartmentalized plastic cases. Labeled rock types include limestone, dolomite, granite, sandstone, shale, marble, gravel, gneiss/schist, basalt, and slate. Metallic ore specimens such as pyrite are included. Contains an amethyst cluster with embedded pyrite, polished tumbled stones including rose quartz, moonstone, opalite, aventurine, sodalite, tiger's eye, and bloodstone. Also features raw quartz crystal clusters, an agate slice pendant with drilled hole, coral fossil fragments, a possible shark tooth fossil, driftwood pieces, and various unpolished rough mineral specimens in earth tones. Items vary in size from small stones to palm-sized specimens. Wear present on items. See photos for condition.
